notes: All 30 source and 30 target ids are partitioned exactly once.

Five articles are unrepresented for two distinct reasons: τῆς and the articles of ψυχή and σῶμα because the ASV writes no determiner for those nouns (rule 23), and τό before πνεῦμα and τοῦ before κυρίου because a possessive occupies the slot (rule 20).
ἀμέμπτως heads on *blame* under rule 84, and κυρίου keeps its *of* discontinuously around *our* under rules 15 and 21.
